policy: PASS at or under warn_beyond x median, WARN up to fail_beyond x median, FAIL beyond fail_beyond x median or on any correctness mismatch. Timing never fails CI on noise: medians are generous and fail_beyond is 10x.

continuation_micro.note: Real RunLoop over scripted model, 8 tool rounds, offline. Typical runs finish in low tens of ms.

session_open.note: Offline assembly (loop + conversation + system prompt) plus 5 scripted turns. No network, no credentials.

replay_golden.note: replay_to_trajectory over each committed fixture plus timeline render. Pure CPU over tiny inputs.
